scope.flow: LaunchToken bonding-curve rewards termination via _decreaseFeeShares/_endRewards after token graduation to AMM trading
scope.environment: GTE launchpad LaunchToken contract with bondingShare mappings, totalFeeShare counter, unlock()/unlocked flag, and AMM pair fee accrual

statements.text: During the bonding curve phase, the unlocked flag is false.
When the token graduates to AMM trading, the unlock() function is called so that unlocked becomes true.
All early buyers have transferred away their tokens so that no bonding shares remain (totalFeeShare == 0).
_decreaseFeeShares() is invoked to decrease fee shares as users transfer tokens away.

The condition `if (totalFeeShare == 0 && !unlocked)` can never be satisfied once unlocked is true, because !unlocked evaluates to false, making the whole condition false regardless of totalFeeShare; thus _endRewards() cleanup never happens after graduation.
The rewards program should end once no bonding shares remain (totalFeeShare == 0), regardless of the token's locked status, so that fee collection from AMM swaps stops.
Rewards should stop when the token graduates to automated market maker trading rather than continuing indefinitely.
This allows early bonding curve buyers to continue earning AMM trading fees indefinitely, even though rewards should stop when the token graduates to automated market maker trading.
This makes early bonding curve buyers continue receiving AMM trading fees indefinitely after token graduation.

ambiguities: Report does not state who calls _decreaseFeeShares() or whether any caller is unauthorized.
Report does not specify the exact transaction ordering between unlock() and the final _decreaseFeeShares() call that exhausts totalFeeShare.
Report does not give numeric values for totalFeeShare or fee amounts.
